newsitem.title: RUSSIA: BASKETBALL-CSKA MOSCOW SUBDUE FUCKA, BEAT MILAN TO GO TOP.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-CSKA MOSCOW SUBDUE FUCKA, BEAT MILAN TO GO TOP.

text.p: CSKA subdued veteran pivot Gregor Fucka to beat Stefanel Milan 70-55 in Moscow on Wednesday and replace them at the top of Euroleague Group A.

The home side's muscular American import Marcus Webb smothered the 2.11 metre Milan marksman in a low-scoring encounter, allowing the Russians to reap the benefit of some deadly shooting from Igor Kudelin, who shot six three-pointers in his 22-point tally.
Fucka was held to just 18 points. He was still Milan's top scorer but was also outshot by CSKA's Valery Dayneko, who matched Kudelin's score of 22.

Leading 10-9 after seven minutes, the Italians let Kudelin in for the first of his three-pointers and were never in front again. In an eight-minute spell up to the 17th minute, Stefanel scored just one point to the Moscow side's 14.
They trailed 35-24 at halftime and, with six minutes to go, were fully 21 points behind with the score at 65-44.
CSKA trainer Stanislav Yeryomin said he thought the visitors had been handicapped by the absence of Flavio Portaluppi.
Stefanel coach Franco Marzaletti singled out Webb for keeping Fucka out of the game for long periods.
